# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the change and the learning problem it addresses.

## Change Type

- [ ] Lesson or documentation
- [ ] TypeScript example
- [ ] Test or tooling
- [ ] Version or dependency update
- [ ] Security improvement
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Repository maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] Type checking passes.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Lint and build checks pass where available.
- [ ] Examples are beginner-friendly and runnable.
- [ ] Runtime validation is used at external-data boundaries where relevant.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or confidential information are included.
- [ ] Dependency and lockfile changes were reviewed.
- [ ] Documentation, commands, paths, imports, and links were checked.
- [ ] Content is original or properly attributed.
- [ ] The contribution is compatible with the MIT License.

## Test Evidence

List commands run and summarize the results.

## Compatibility and Security Impact

Describe version requirements, breaking changes, trust boundaries, or security considerations.
